  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD

Erik Frost Hollins, President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Vice President  Victoria Love, Commissioner
  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  SPECIAL MEETING

  CIVILSERVICECOMMISSION@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Civil Service Commission on agenda items.

 CLOSED SESSION

 1.  24-53094  Closed Session – Personnel Session Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(B)(1).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-53095  Recommendation to approve protest of written examination – Police Sergeant.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Liz Rodriguez, Executive Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please call the Civil Service Commission at (562) 570-6203 or
 CivilServiceCommission@longbeach.gov, the day prior to the meeting.

CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MINUTES

  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CHAMBERS, 8:30 AM

Erik Frost Hollins, President  Joen Garnica, Commissioner
Robyn Gordon-Peterson, Vice President  Victoria Love, Commissioner
  Jose Osuna, Commissioner

Christina Pizarro Winting, Executive Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 8:34 AM, President Frost Hollins called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Commissioners Present: Love, Osuna, Frost Hollins

 Commissioners Absent: Garnica, Gordon-Peterson

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 Steve Costa, Lieuteanant, Police Department, led the Pledge of Allegiance.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 There was no public comment.

 CLOSED SESSION

 1.  24-53094  Closed Session – Personnel Session Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(B)(1).

  This Agenda Item was received and filed.

 2.  24-53095  Recommendation to approve protest of written examination – Police Sergeant.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Osuna, seconded by
  Commissioner Love, to approve recommendation, as amended, to
  approve the staff recommendations of protest. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  3 Love, Osuna, Frost Hollins
  No:  0 None
